description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the Eval PPL (evaluated Perplexity) and the Activated Parameters Ratio (%) for four different models: Transformer, Only MoHD FFN, Only MoHD ATTN, and MoHD ATTN + MLP. The x-axis, labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)", is scaled logarithmically and ranges from 25 to 100, with tick marks at 25, 75, and 100. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL", is linear and ranges from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The red dashed line, representing the Transformer model, remains constant at an Eval PPL of 11.5 across all values of the activated parameters ratio. The gray dashed line, representing the Only MoHD FFN model, starts at an Eval PPL of 11.5 at 100% activation, decreases to a minimum of 11.5 at 75% activation, and then increases to 11.7 at 25% activation. The dark blue solid line, representing the Only MoHD ATTN model, starts at an Eval PPL of 11.5 at 100% activation, increases to 12.0 at 75% activation, and then sharply increases to 14.0 at 25% activation. The light blue solid line, representing the MoHD ATTN + MLP model, starts at an Eval PPL of 11.5 at 100% activation, increases to 11.7 at 75% activation, and then continues to increase to 13.1 at 25% activation.
